title: Compare repair and replacement using actual quotes
summary: For a durable item, compare a real repair quote and replacement price, while considering safety, warranty, parts, and expected use.
content:
Before replacing a durable item, describe the fault and request a repair quote. Compare that quote with a current replacement price, including installation or delivery where relevant. Consider warranty, parts availability, product safety, and how long the item is expected to remain useful.

Do not continue using unsafe electrical or gas equipment to avoid replacement. This comparison does not quantify lifecycle emissions or claim that repair is always the better choice.
applicability_conditions: Considering a repair or replacement of a durable product
implementation_steps: Record the item, fault, and safety concerns
Get a repair quote from a service provider you select
Record the current replacement price and warranty
Compare the options without treating an estimate as an invoice
limitations: Repair quality, parts availability, and price vary
No lifecycle impact estimate is supplied
